acceptance_predicates.description: A fresh project installs supported tools/workloads by ID, selects them, and completes a bounded benchmark/report/compare journey.
Run evidence proves execution used the selected project-local acquired/built identity and rejects ambient substitution or stale/revoked/mismatched records.
Verified reuse, official prebuilt, source fallback, local dependency closure, offline-after-install, update, repair, remove, and recovery are qualified.
Tool/workload acquisition and build failures remain distinct from benchmark/provider failures and preserve usable prior state.

definition_of_done: Independent end-to-end fresh-user evidence covers every supported installation class and a representative official source path.
Exact-head review, signed merge, and exact-main hosted qualification pass.

inputs.description: AR-1764 project tools/catalogs consumed by execution.

outputs.description: Privacy-safe exact identity evidence for installed tools/workloads through ASB execution.

gates.description: Fresh-user install/select/run/report/compare path proves exact installed identity use.
All acquisition, build, update, removal, offline, mismatch, and failure-boundary tests pass.
